title: myfind
summary: find DIR -name NAME: every entry with that exact name, in a tree of any depth.
hints: A helper `walk(const char *dir)` calls itself for each subdirectory. Build the child path with `snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s", dir, name)`, and **skip `.` and `..`**: without that the recursion never ends.

Compare `e->d_name` with the name you look for (`strcmp`) for every entry, directory or not, and also descend into it if it is a directory. An entry is a directory if `opendir(path)` succeeds (close it again with `closedir`); otherwise treat it as a file.
